about: Each name's builds, by the date its read set was taken (Session 27, Nov 14). Between triggers a card is served from its last build: its read set is the one that build read, and later filings that are not refresh triggers are listed, not read (lib/cache/lastBuild.ts). Added when a build bills or is signed. eightKRule: the 8-K rule the build read under (Nov 16: every build recorded before the Nov 14 decision read under rule 1; a new build reads under rule 2).
